reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it primarily teaches a second-level stock-market reasoning approach and explicitly characterizes an example as not being a stock recommendation. It discusses possible profits and market predictions while acknowledging severe possible losses and displaying an educational disclaimer. Although a Demat-account link and course contact are promoted, the available video evidence does not establish deception or guaranteed returns.

I am taking the example not stock recommendation

opening.argument: Judge, the earning pitch is tied to a concrete action. The description tells viewers to open an account through a supplied link and then says they can start earning through referrals. The speaker closes by repeatedly urging viewers to open the account through the description or comment link. That makes the account-opening step part of an income solicitation, not merely a passing mention of a tool used for investing. The video does not explain the referral terms alongside that invitation.

Start earning with refer and earn.
So today open your Demat account There is a link in the description and comment box in this video by simply clicking on it you can open your Demat account

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's point that an investment example is not a stock recommendation does not answer the separate referral-earning invitation. Nor does acknowledging possible trading losses explain the terms of that invitation. The account is not mentioned only as background: viewers are told to open it through the linked flow, while the description presents referral earnings as a reason to act.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited description says only to open a free account and mentions referral earning; it does not promise a particular payment, conceal a condition, or show that anyone is misled. The video's substantive advice concerns how to evaluate possible investments, including the possibility of severe loss. A referral invitation alongside that discussion is insufficient to establish a scam.

citations.quote: Open Free Demat Account on Upstox: https://bit.ly/DematAcUpstox - NO AMC Charges for Lifetime Offers valid for Limited Time. Start earning with refer and earn.
you will also face severe loss

opening.argument: Consider the signals together: the description pairs a free account offer with a limited-time claim and referral earnings, while the lesson emphasizes the prospect of huge profits from investing against the market. The speaker then presses viewers to open the linked account today. A careful judge need not treat any one phrase as a guaranteed return to see the concern: the presentation combines an exceptional upside narrative, urgency, and an immediate route into the activity being promoted.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the speaker mentions losses, but that caveat does not erase the simultaneous claim that correct contrarian predictions can make a lot of money. Calling an example 'not stock recommendation' also leaves the limited-time account offer and referral-earning prompt untouched. The issue is the combined inducement, not whether every investment is presented as risk-free.

if you predict against the market then your prediction should be correct and you will make a lot of money
Offers valid for Limited Time. Start earning with refer and earn.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those phrases warrant scrutiny, but their combination does not establish deception. The speaker conditions the prospect of making money on a correct prediction and expressly discusses severe losses. The limited-time language concerns the account offer; the cited material does not say investment profits are guaranteed or time-limited.

opening.argument: The teaching format also serves a promotional path. The title promises a way to make money in stocks; the discussion develops an investing method; and the close tells viewers they need an account, directs them to the description link, and urges them to open one today. The description adds a separate referral-earning invitation. Read together, the lesson is not just analysis of markets: it steers viewers from an income-oriented explanation to account signup and potential referral participation.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense emphasizes the length and substance of the market discussion. That discussion is real, but it does not make the closing request incidental: the speaker explicitly connects investing to needing an account and points viewers to the link. The disclaimer about a stock example addresses what to buy, not the invitation to sign up and earn through referrals.

The cited close presents an account as a means to invest or trade, while the lesson discusses how predictions can fail as well as succeed. The referral phrase does not establish deceptive terms or a promised investment return.
